$comment: Email -> active role mapping for the UAT runner persona-inference path. Source of truth is src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Data/SeedData.cs GetUserRoleAssignments. The runner reads the first sign-in step's email from a checklist, looks up the active role here, and passes --active-role <name> to the W0 CLI so the SemanticValidator filters catalog entries against the concrete role rather than the AnyRole wildcard. When a user has multiple roles (e.g., admin@acmecoffee.com), the entry records the role under which that persona drives the canonical UAT flow.
